content: Two synthetic exact-string requests and a real /compact command; no conversation fixtures or injected replacement services in the browser.

configuration.workspaceSetup: Existing authenticated workspace/create API over a disposable directory, followed by UI session creation.
configuration.paneOpened: Existing persisted open preference, followed by browser reload. No new UI trigger was added.

setupCorrections: The initial workspace controls invoked two native directory-picker subprocesses. Both were terminated without interacting with the native dialogs; their browser error dialogs were dismissed and setup used the existing Web API instead.
The first workspace/create request omitted the descriptor's request wrapper and was rejected; the corrected request passed.
The first screenshot used the CLI's CSS scale; it was replaced with an explicitly device-scaled capture before publication.
The initial clipboard assertion guessed sentence-case feedback; the observed existing label is Summary Copied, and actual clipboard content was verified.
publication: Only validated allowlisted PNGs and this proof were copied into a temporary sibling and atomically renamed into the report directory.
limits: No fresh Electron, installed-package, Nix, or hosted CI run for this browser-client-only follow-up.
The wider local root suite is not green: 1273 passed, 14 skipped, one unchanged live Translate debounce integration timed out (tockteam-fno).
No new shell was started by browser interaction; Web composition smoke separately checked and cleaned its PTY.
